trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] RETURN DISTINCT c.population AS col1, p.position AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.founded_year AS col4, p.name AS col5, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team, c.city_name AS name_city

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City), (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND (p.current_team = t.team_name OR EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' }) RETURN DISTINCT c.population AS col1, p.position AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.founded_year AS col4, p.name AS col5, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team, c.city_name AS name_city

MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE p.current_team = t.team_name RETURN DISTINCT c.population AS col1, p.position AS col2, c.city_name AS col3, t.founded_year AS col4, p.name AS col5, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team, c.city_name AS name_city
